sources.title: Breaking Down the 2025 Topps Exalted WWE Hobby Box
sources.text: Breaking Down the 2025 Topps Exalted WWE Hobby Box What You’ll Find in WWE’s Newest Product DATE: MAR 2, 2026 TOPICS: 2025 TOPPS EXALTED WWE, TRENDING, WRESTLING, WWE LENGTH: 716 WORDS READING TIME: ~4 MINUTES The 2025 Topps Exalted WWE Hobby Box introduces a new premium tier in WWE trading cards, combining elevated design, on-card autographs, and superstar-driven storytelling in a streamlined five-card format. The 2025 Topps Exalted WWE Hobby Box is a premium WWE trading card release featuring two autographs and one relic per box. With a 100-card base set, numbered parallels down to 1/1, and dual autograph rivalries, Exalted delivers a high-end collecting experience built around WWE legends and current superstars. FIND EXALTED ON TOPPS What is 2025 Topps Exalted WWE? 2025 Topps Exalted WWE marks the debut of the Exalted brand in WWE trading cards. Built as a premium hobby-only release, it emphasizes refined aesthetics, strong autograph depth, and meaningful relic themes centered on the biggest names in sports entertainment. Each hobby box contains one pack with five cards : 1 Base Card 1 Numbered Base Parallel 2 Autographs 1 Relic Every box delivers two autographs and one relic, giving collectors a high-impact rip experience. 2025 Topps Exalted WWE Base Set Breakdown The base set includes 100 cards, featuring 90 top WWE superstars and legends, plus 10 iconic WWE moments. The checklist spans multiple eras, pairing today’s headliners with all-time greats. Exalted Parallels: Collectors can pursue a structured parallel rainbow: Aqua /99 Green /50 Blue /25 Red /5 Black 1/1 The Black 1/1 represents the ultimate expression of the Exalted design and the pinnacle base chase. Design-wise, Exalted stands apart with: Matte card stock Raised UV detailing Layered color flows in blues, aquas, teals, and whites A river-inspired visual texture for premium depth Autographs in 2025 Topps Exalted WWE Autographs anchor the product’s premium identity. Key Signers: John Cena The Rock Triple H Roman Reigns Stone Cold Steve Austin Cody Rhodes The Undertaker Tiffany Stratton Stephanie Vaquer Jordynne Grace Notable additions include Mark Henry, returning names Rusev and Aleister Black, and Rey Fenix with his first WWE autograph. Superstar Rivalry Signatures This dual autograph set highlights iconic WWE pairings: Triple H and The Rock Triple H and Shawn Michaels Stephanie McMahon and Trish Stratus There are 53 total dual autographs across these three combinations, making them cornerstone chases. Signature Styles to Know Insignia Ink Acetate Autos – Shadowbox-style acetate layer with integrated logos Black and White Signatures – Full-bleed photography presentation Additional themes: Exalted Autos, Streamline Signatures, Ambient Autos, Elevated Ink, Apparition Autos Relic Content & Insert Themes Exalted balances autograph strength with premium relic storytelling. John Cena: The Last Time Is Now Relics Focused on Cena’s final year in WWE, anchoring a narrative-driven chase. Mega Materials Oversized jumbo swatches paired with bold superstar imagery. Rivaled Dual Relics Two-superstar relic pairings centered on historic rivalries. Tag Team Relics and Quad Relics Multi-window configurations featuring tag teams and four-superstar combinations. Celebrating Cena and The Rock A retrospective continuity concept honoring defining WWE milestones. The Exalted Standard With two autographs and one relic per box, a 100-card base set, structured parallels, and on-card signature depth, the 2025 Topps Exalted WWE Hobby Box establishes a refined premium tier within WWE trading cards. Collectors should look for: On-card autos from cornerstone superstars First WWE signatures and long-awaited returns Dual autograph rivalries John Cena farewell relic content Black 1/1 base parallels 2025 Topps Exalted WWE delivers a premium collecting experience rooted in design innovation, autograph strength, and WWE legacy storytelling.
